esqlQuery.esql:
FROM events-user-*
| WHERE event.type IN ("user.searched", "user.clicked_result")
| EVAL is_recent = CASE(@timestamp >= NOW() - 60 minutes, 1, 0), is_search = CASE(event.type == "user.searched", 1, 0), is_click = CASE(event.type == "user.clicked_result", 1, 0)
| STATS recent_searches = SUM(is_recent * is_search), recent_clicks = SUM(is_recent * is_click), baseline_searches = SUM((1 - is_recent) * is_search), baseline_clicks = SUM((1 - is_recent) * is_click)
| EVAL recent_ctr = TO_DOUBLE(recent_clicks) / recent_searches, baseline_ctr = TO_DOUBLE(baseline_clicks) / baseline_searches
| WHERE recent_searches >= 30 AND recent_ctr < 0.5 * baseline_ctr
| KEEP recent_searches, recent_clicks, recent_ctr, baseline_searches, baseline_ctr
